text:
rachel: Heads-up from today's calls — three pilots keep circling back to two asks: deterministic egress IPs and a "just works" installer. They explicitly deprioritized BGP for now.

tom: TL;DR proposal for MVP network surface: (A) static egress mapping (single IP or small pool), (B) zero-touch installer with sane defaults + clear preflight, (C) opt-in relay for behind-NAT installs, (D) minimal BYOK KMS support. Everything else -> v2.

anika: Engineering notes: two main ways to achieve egress IPs: operator NAT/relay or cluster SNAT. Relay is faster to ship for complex customer topologies (no infra changes), but it's an operational component we host/support. SNAT is lighter weight but requires coop from customer netops.

raj: Security asks: BYOK is required by at least one pilot. For MVP we should support customer-managed keys for data-at-rest encryption only (no cross-region key rotation, no policies). Legal wants explicit docs on key access model.

infra-bot: CI: operator-bundle build 2026-04-02-3 complete. smoke: 24/25 pass. failing: windows port preflight (icmp/udp) flake.

maya: Console UX: add a "Network readiness" tile showing: Preflight (ok/warn/fail), Egress mapping config, Relay status. Single CTA: "Resolve network" that expands to checklist and firewall rules to open. Reuse hosted checklist patterns.

owen: Rollout/upgrade thoughts: plan canary -> pilot cohort -> GA. Must support in-place bundle upgrades and an offline bundle for air-gapped customers. Rollback steps documented and tested in staging. Also add a feature flag for per-tenant egress mapping in the Console.

tom: Perf tradeoff: relay adds latency; we should publish a small table in docs (US-west ~+60ms, eu-west ~+80-120ms). Provide an optional local-model fallback policy when latency breaches config (e.g., if p95 > 200ms).

anika: Implementation spike items: 1) relay PoC + perf matrix, 2) SNAT recipe + ops doc, 3) windows preflight fix. Estimate: 2 sprints to have robust PoC + tests.

rachel: Prioritization note: sales flagged AcmeHealth and VaultOps as "must-have egress" for their trials. If we don't land basic mapping + installer by end of sprint, pilots will pause. Keep scope narrow.

owen: Action owners: anika -> relay PoC & SNAT doc by Fri, raj -> BYOK sample config & legal note by Mon, infra -> windows preflight fix (triage) by Wed, maya -> Console tile mock + copy by Tue, tom -> customer comms draft + pilot alignment by Tue.

rachel: I'll collate this into the private-deploy roadmap doc and add a short customer-facing FAQ. tagging owners here. :thumbsup:
